info.title: pdfrender
info.description:
HTML and CSS to PDF API and MCP server. WeasyPrint with page headers, footers and page numbers, no headless browser. Hosted in Germany.

Base URL: `https://api.pdfrender.dev`.

### Authentication
Send your key in the `X-API-Key` header. Calls without a key run anonymously at
a lower rate limit per IP address.

### Rate limits
Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and
`X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the window resets). Over-budget calls return
`429` with a `Retry-After` header. Check your live budget at `GET /v1/me`.

### Pagination
List endpoints return a keyset envelope: `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`.
Pass `next_cursor` back as the `?cursor=` query param for the next page; it is
`null` on the last page.

### Errors
Errors are [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `problem+json` with a
stable machine-readable **`code`** (e.g. `rate_limited`, `credits_exhausted`,
`validation_error`). Branch on `code`. The `title` and `detail` text may change.

### Quickstart
```sh
curl -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" https://api.pdfrender.dev/v1/me
```

get.summary: Your plan, remaining requests, and remaining credits
get.description:
Check where you stand before a call fails.

Returns the plan this request runs on and whether your key was recognized.
Without an `X-API-Key`, the call runs anonymously at the rate limit for
calls without a key. It also returns the requests left in the current window
and the features your plan includes. On plans priced in credits, it returns
the credits left in the current billing period.

This call does not count against your rate limit, so the numbers it reports
are the numbers you have.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

post.summary: Render an HTML document to a PDF
post.description:
Send an HTML document and get the PDF back as a download.

Inline images, fonts and CSS as `data:` URIs. External resources (http,
https, file) are not loaded: a document that references one is rejected with
400, and the detail lists the URLs. Relative URLs are ignored. JavaScript is
not run.

Limits: 2 MB of HTML, 50 pages, and 20 seconds including time in the queue.
Without an API key, the limit is 8 seconds and one render runs at a time.

On a paid plan, set `pdf_variant` to `pdf/a-2b` or `pdf/a-3b` for PDF/A
output.

Works without an API key for 10 requests a day per IP address. With a
key, a rejected or failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 1 per call.

200.description: The PDF, as a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`).

400.description: The HTML references an external resource (`external_resource_blocked`). The detail lists the URLs.

402.description: The credit balance is used up (`credits_exhausted`).

403.description: `pdf_variant` was set without a paid plan (`feature_not_available`). The `upgrade_url` starts the checkout.

413.description: The HTML is larger than 2 MB (`html_too_large`).

422.description: The request body is invalid (`validation_error`), or the document has more than 50 pages (`too_many_pages`).

429.description: The rate limit is reached (`rate_limited`). Retry after the seconds in the `Retry-After` header. Without an API key, one render runs at a time: a second one gets `render_busy`. Retry in a few seconds, or use a key.

500.description: The document could not be rendered (`render_failed`).

504.description: The render took longer than 20 seconds with an API key, or 8 seconds without one (`render_timeout`).

CreditsInfo.title: CreditsInfo
CreditsInfo.description:
Your credit balance for the current billing period. `granted` is what
your plan included, `balance` what is still unspent, and `period_end` the
date (ISO 8601) your allowance refills. Present only on plans that are
priced in credits.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The plan this request is served on.

is_keyed.title: Is Keyed
is_keyed.description: Whether the request carried a valid API key. Without an `X-API-Key`, the call runs anonymously at the rate limit for calls without a key.

credits.description: Null on plans that are not priced in credits.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
The `GET /v1/me` payload: who the request is authenticated as, what is
left of your request and credit allowances, and which features your plan
includes.

RateLimitInfo.title: RateLimitInfo
RateLimitInfo.description:
How many requests you may still make in the current window. These are the
same numbers as the `X-RateLimit-*` response headers. `limit` is the size of the
window, `remaining` what is left of it, and `reset` how many seconds until
it refills (not a timestamp). All three are `null` in the rare case the
counter cannot be read; treat that as "unknown", not zero.

html.title: Html
html.description: The HTML document, up to 2 MB. Inline images, fonts and CSS as data: URIs; external resources are not loaded. JavaScript is not run.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Filename of the downloaded PDF. Characters other than A–Z, a–z, 0–9, `.`, `_` and `-` become `_`, and `.pdf` is added if missing.

pdf_variant.title: Pdf Variant
pdf_variant.description: Write the PDF as PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b, for archiving. Paid plans only: without one, the call gets 403 `feature_not_available` with an `upgrade_url`. Leave it out for a regular PDF.

RenderRequest.title: RenderRequest
RenderRequest.description: An HTML document to render, an optional filename and an optional PDF/A variant.
